title: SIDESTORY: ADVENTURE THAT CANNOT WAIT FOR THE SUN OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: ADVENTURE THAT CANNOT WAIT FOR THE SUN OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, participating in Gemstone Engravings, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
Phase 1 'Citizen's Garden'
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 6, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Phase 2 'Harvest Gathering'
DURATION: January 23, 2025, 16:00 – February 6, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Phase 3 'Treasure House'
DURATION: January 30, 2025, 16:00 – February 6, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Gemstone Engravings]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Gemstone Engravings] courses to gain rewards.
REWARDS: Ha'maimenat Garden (Pieces), Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
[Event Guidebook]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Event Guidebook] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Papyrus], Ha'maimenat Garden (Pieces), Flowing Glimmerdust, Module Materials, etc.
[Grand Bazaar]
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Flowing Glimmerdust by clearing event stages and completing [Grand Bazaar] missions. Flowing Glimmerdust can be used to redeem items from [Grand Bazaar].

REWARDS: Papyrus's token, Ha'maimenat Garden (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, [★★★★★: Tuye], Tuye's token, Vitafield [Rewilder] Series - Bitter Herbs for Myrrh, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
Please refer to the official introduction for more details.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 L IMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ENGRAVER OF QUICKSAND
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – January 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [Engraver of Quicksand], the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Pepe [Limited] / Narantuya
★★★★★★: Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska [Limited] / Gavial the Invincible [Limited] / Ch'en the Holungday [Limited]
★★★★★: Sand Reckoner

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Pepe after a total of 300 rolls (once only) . This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
NOTE:
- [Engraver of Quicksand] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
- Narantuya and Sand Reckoner will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after January 30, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Operator Pepe is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – January 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players can log in during the event to claim the reward on the event page: Bright Glitter Headhunting Permit * 1
NOTE:

- Bright Glitter Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Engraver of Quicksand] Limited Headhunting. - Bright Glitter Headhunting Permit expires at: January 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
04 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] DAILY FREE ROLL IN [ ENGRAVER OF QUICKSAND ] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – January 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Engraver of Quicksand] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE:
- Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW OPERATOR NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game
★★★★★★: Pepe [Limited]
★★★★★★: Narantuya
★★★★★: Sand Reckoner
★★★★★: Papyrus
Note:
- Operator Papyrus is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- Pepe, Narantuya, Sand Reckoner, and Papyrus will gain more trust in the event stages during January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 6, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7).
06 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] BRILLIANT SUN RIPPLING SAND SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – January 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, etc.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate* 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Plaque 'Orange Storm' * 1
Day 4: Chip Catalyst * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 5: Tactical Battle Record * 20, 'Orange Sandstorm' Furniture * 1
Day 6: Orundum * 200, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 8: LMD * 30000, Data Supplement Stick * 10
Day 9: Orundum * 200, Furniture Part * 300
Day 10: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
NOTE:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
07 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] BAZAAR WISHING WALL OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – January 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Wishing Tickets after daily login. Consume trials to participate in [Bazaar Wishing Wall]. The Wishing Tickets with the most Orundum will be awarded. Both trials for the day must be used before claiming the reward.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Wishing Tickets.
- Players will randomly obtain the following amount of Orundum from Wishing Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am (UTC-7) on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
08 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - A Picnic Before A Long Trip for Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska
EPOQUE Collection - To Rest in Night Breezes for Poncirus
Misaligned Sightseer Collection - Iakhu of Flows for Nightingale
Misaligned Sightseer Collection - Courtyard of Neka for Hoederer
Misaligned Sightseer Collection - Sedjem for Weedy
09 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] CORAL COAST COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Colorful Wonderland CW03 for Surtr
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA210 for La Pluma
Coral Coast Collection - Shimmering Dew SDm11 for Elysium
Coral Coast Collection - Holiday HDm74 for Minimalist
10 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] RHODES FASHION REVIEW OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: 129 Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including: Bloodline of Combat Collection - Forerunner for Gnosis, Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided - Obsidian for Mudrock, Achievement Star Collection - Sport For All for Flametail
11 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW FURNITURE SETS - 'UNDER THE SANDBANK' LUXURY SUITE & HA'MAIMENAT GARDEN & BUNNY BONANZA
DETAILS: Brand new sets of themed Furniture, 'Under The Sandbank' Luxury Suite, Ha'maimenat Garden, and Bunny Bonanza will be available.
'Under The Sandbank' Luxury Suite
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Limited-time sale at the Store: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Ha'maimenat Garden
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun event rewards (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Bunny Bonanza
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Limited-time sale at the Store: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
12 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] OPERATOR SAVAGE FREE TO CLAIM FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: After the event begins, [★★★★★: Savage] * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail.
Mail will be sent on : January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Available for claim: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Mail will be sent to: All Doctors who registered and created an account before January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
NOTE:
Players who already have Operator Savage will obtain Savage's Token * 1 from this email, which can be used to improve the Potential of Savage.
13 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SENIOR OPERATOR TRANSFER PERMIT FREE TO CLAIM FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: After the event begins, Senior Operator Transfer Permit * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail. Players can use this permit to redeem one of the 5* Operators within range.
All possible Operators: a 5-star Operator from a past Headhunting Pool up to and including 'As In My Adumbration.' (Excluding Collaboration Operators and Recruitment-only Operators)
Mail will be sent on : January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Available for claim: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Mail will be sent to: All Doctors who registered and created an account before January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
14 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] ORIGINIUM FIRST-TIME PURCHASE RESET
RESET TIME: January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Resets all players' Originium first-time purchase bonus. After reset, players can get double Originium for the first-time purchase again.
15 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] FESTIVAL PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Holiday Training Data Pack]
CONTENTS: Module Data Block * 12
[Holiday Training Data Set]
CONTENTS: Module Data Block * 24, Data Supplement Instrument * 30, Data Supplement Stick * 90
[Comprehensive Skill Training Pack] (Limited to 2 purchases)
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 12, Top Operator Skill Training Pack * 1, Senior Operator Skill Training Pack * 1, Professional Operator Skill Training Pack * 1
Top Operator Skill Training Pack: You can select a 6-star Operator that meets the requirements and level a skill to Specialization Level 3
[Radiant Treasure Pack]

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 260000, Strategic Battle Record * 30, Chip Catalyst * 4, Module Data Block * 4, Data Supplement Instrument * 20, Data Supplement Stick * 60
[Pepe's Briefcase]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 16, LMD * 700000
[Special Training Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 11, Senior Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Senior Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 5-star operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 80. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
[Advanced Special Training Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 19, Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1
Top Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 90. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
[Celebration of Flood Pack]

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 24, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, LMD *200000, Strategic Battle Record * 20, Tactical Battle Record * 30, Chip Catalyst * 2, Premium Material Voucher * 4, Advanced Material Voucher * 6
16 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
DURATION: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 13, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Guard Chip Pack]
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
[Sniper Chip Pack]
CONTENTS: Sniper Dualchip * 4, Sniper Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
[Senior Operator Training Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 24, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1

Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter : Use to level up a 5-star operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 1. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
[Top Operator Training Pack]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 36, Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1
Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 1. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
[Monthly Battle Record Pack]
DURATION: Available from January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7). Limited to 3 purchases per month.
CONTENTS: Strategic Battle Record * 80, Tactical Battle Record * 100, Frontline Battle Record * 160
[Monthly Funding Pack]
DURATION: Available from January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7). Limited to 3 purchases per month.
CONTENTS: LMD * 240000
NOTE:

- After the update on January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), Premium Material Vouchers and Advanced Material Vouchers obtained from the [Material Issue Voucher Pack] will be permanently available. Vouchers obtained from the previous month's pack before January 16, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7) will still expire.
- From January 16, 04:00 to 10:00 (UTC-7), the [Material Issue Voucher Pack] will be temporarily unavailable in the store.
17 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW REDEEMABLE AVAILABLE IN [DISTINCTIONS] AND [UNIVERSAL CERTIFICATES EXCHANGE AREA]
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: New redeemable in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area]:
EPOQUE Collection - Invisible Dirge for Manticore
18 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] RECRUITMENT OPERATORS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, the following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment.
★★★★★★ Mudrock
★★★★★ Whisperain
★★★★ Jackie
NOTE:
- During the update, tags that have not yet been used for recruitment will be refreshed. Please stay tuned for further information.
19 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW LUCKY DROP FURNITURE SET – MIDNIGHT BLUE SELF-SERVICE BAR
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
LUCKY DROP: Themed furniture - Midnight Blue Self-Service Bar
HOW TO OBTAIN: Main Theme stages (excluding Challenge Mode and Tutorial) Lucky Drop, Supplies stage Lucky Drop.

DETAILS: New "Midnight Blue Self-Service Bar" themed furniture will replace the existing Lucky Drop "Catastrophe Observatory" themed furniture. The "Catastrophe Observatory" themed furniture will be available in the Furniture Store.
"Catastrophe Observatory" will be available from: January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
20 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SPECIALIZED MODULES UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Specialized Modules will be available, effective in certain game modes.
Operators with Specialized Modules in current update: Kal'tsit, Phantom. Their Specialized Modules can take effect in [Integrated Strategies].
NOTE:
- There are no unlock missions for Specialized Modules, and the materials needed for unlocking and upgrading them are significantly reduced compared to regular modules.

- After the update on January 16, 10:00 (UTC-7), the Trust required for unlocking all modules will be reduced from 100 to 0. The Trust required for upgrading modules to Level 2 and Level 3 will be adjusted to 50 and 100, respectively.
21 [5TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] THEMED BACKGROUND RERUN
UPDATE TIME: January 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players can unlock the new Themed Background by reaching specified conditions. The Themed Background can be viewed and changed on the main menu.
[Celebration]
AVAILABLE FOR CLAIM: January 16, 2025, 10:00 – February 17, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK CONDITIONS: After the event begins, players can log in to claim the new Themed Background.
OTHERS:
Ideal City: Endless Carnival available in [Side Story]
Available from: January 30, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
FURNITURE: Great Aquapit Funtastic Experientorium (Pieces)
Available from: January 30, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
